set.body: Pilot-scoped (owner D1). Design how the Scala side ingests generator datasets (schema tools/phrf-comparison/generator/SCHEMA.md), invokes PHRF (condition and trial ML paths at the bound source), CAN/INF3/FIR, LSA/LSS/rLSS and the GLMsingle wrapper on the 7 pilot cells. Define the output: only variance components of centred differences, ICCs, pooled refusal rates and timings, never comparative results. Define custody: beacon-A root and a non-author custodian (default backlog-worker-20260930). Deliverable: a design doc and Mote slice list; no implementation.
set.title: PHRF-CMP pilot runner: design and slicing
